description: A dentist's chair with the upholstery long gone, bolted to the floor under a hood of salvaged medical gear and a great many cable ties. Somebody has written STILLHOUSE on the hood in correction fluid and then, underneath, in a different hand, IT DOES NOT HURT. The second claim is doing considerably more work than the first. Whatever it takes out of you goes into a sealed drum beside the chair, and the drum is nearly full.
name: the stillhouse chair
